zh-HK.title: 慈善捐款扣稅計算機
zh-HK.s1.months.label: 本課稅年度的捐款月數
zh-HK.s1.months.hint: 課稅年度至 3 月 31 日止；扣稅按全年捐款總額計算。
zh-HK.s1.band.label: 您全年應評稅入息（大約）
zh-HK.s1.band.hint: 未扣除免稅額；基本免稅額以 HK$145,000 估算。
zh-HK.s1.band.aria: 您全年應評稅入息（大約）
zh-HK.s1.band.r0.label: HK$145,000 以下
zh-HK.s1.band.r16.label: HK$5,000,000 以上
zh-HK.s1.band.note: 應評稅入息淨額超過 HK$2,132,500 後，稅務局改用標準稅率計算：首 HK$500 萬 15%，其後 16%。因此最頂兩級的比率回落，而非上升 —— 這是薪俸稅的設計，並非計算錯誤。
zh-HK.s1.mob.r0: HK$145,000 以下 · 無須繳稅
zh-HK.s1.exact.label: 全年應評稅入息
zh-HK.s1.exact.hint: 由範圍改為單一數字，並計入累進稅級及 35% 上限。只用於本頁計算，不會傳送或儲存。
zh-HK.s1.what.body: 只有捐予《稅務條例》第 88 條認可慈善團體的款項才可扣稅。換取貨品、服務或利益的付款不屬捐款，例如獎券、拍賣購入的物品、慈善晚宴或酒席、以及帶廣告回報的贊助。應評稅入息不高於基本免稅額者無須繳付薪俸稅，捐款亦不會減少稅款。
zh-HK.s2.caption: 按所選入息範圍的下限與上限計算。
zh-HK.s2.benefit: 您捐 HK$1,300，全數可作認可慈善捐款扣除。每捐 HK$100，實際付出約 HK$83。
zh-HK.s2.cap.def: 扣稅上限為應評稅入息的 35%（全年合計）；一般捐款不會觸及上限。
zh-HK.s2.scope: 只估算個人在薪俸稅下的捐款扣稅，並非稅務建議。
zh-HK.s2.spouse.q: 夫婦的扣稅額可否合併使用？
zh-HK.s2.spouse.a: 可以，但只限未用的部分。您未能用盡的扣稅額（包括超出 35% 上限而未扣除的部分），配偶可在其 BIR60 報稅表內申報；配偶本人的申報同樣以 35% 為上限，上限按其本人的入息或利潤計算，因此未用的扣稅額不能全數轉移。
zh-HK.s3.lede: 三種方式均於護瞳行動的捐款頁完成。
zh-HK.rc.lede: 三項資料：收據抬頭、電郵，以及付款參考編號。
zh-HK.rc.threshold: 課稅年度內捐款總額滿 HK$100，方會發出正式收據。
zh-HK.rc.name: 姓名（收據抬頭）
zh-HK.rc.ref.hint: 付款 App 交易紀錄或信用卡收據上的交易編號。
zh-HK.rc.consent: 本人同意護瞳行動使用上述資料核對捐款，並發出扣稅收據。
zh-HK.rc.disclink: 提交前請先閱讀免責聲明。
zh-HK.rc.keep: 請保留收據六年；稅務局可能要求查閱。
zh-HK.rc.disc.body: 僅為估算，並非稅務建議，亦不能取代專業意見。估算依稅務局截至 3 月 31 日止課稅年度的規定，只計入認可慈善捐款的扣稅，並無計及其他扣除、免稅額或稅務寬減；亦不涵蓋利潤稅、個人入息課稅或夫婦合併評稅。實際可扣除金額及應繳稅款以稅務局評定為準。本計算機不收集、不儲存任何資料；您在此提供的姓名、電郵及付款參考編號，只用於核對捐款及發出收據。
zh-HK.foot.legal: * 實際可扣除金額以稅務局評定為準。上限為應評稅入息或利潤的 35%；所節省的稅款約為可扣除金額乘以適用稅率（最高 17%）。
zh-HK.d.cap.monthly: 每月 {a} × {n} 個月 = 全年 {total}。
zh-HK.d.cap.empty: 輸入捐款金額後即會顯示。
zh-HK.d.cap.exact: 按您輸入的 {inc} 精確計算。
zh-HK.d.cap.unknown: 未指定入息範圍：下限為節省 HK$0，上限為最高邊際稅率 17%。
zh-HK.d.cap.range: 按所選範圍的上下限計算。
zh-HK.d.cap.same: 在所選入息範圍內，節省稅款相同。
zh-HK.d.assume.exact: 假設應評稅入息為 {inc}（您輸入的數字）。
zh-HK.d.capline.empty: 扣稅上限為應評稅入息的 35%（全年合計）。
zh-HK.d.capline.exact.capped: 扣稅上限為應評稅入息的 35%（全年合計）：可扣除 {taxed}，其餘不能扣除。
zh-HK.d.capline.exact.ok: 扣稅上限為應評稅入息的 35%（全年合計）；未觸及上限，全數可扣除。
zh-HK.d.capline.unknown: 扣稅上限為應評稅入息的 35%（全年合計）；已計入上限。
zh-HK.d.capline.zero: 扣稅上限為應評稅入息的 35%（全年合計）；捐款仍可扣除，但沒有應繳稅款可減少。
zh-HK.d.capline.band.capped: 扣稅上限為應評稅入息的 35%（全年合計）；所選範圍下限可扣除 {d}。
zh-HK.d.capline.band.ok: 扣稅上限為應評稅入息的 35%（全年合計）；所選範圍下限全數可扣除。
zh-HK.d.benefit.empty: 輸入捐款金額後，即顯示實際付出。
zh-HK.d.benefit.range: 您捐 {g}，可作認可慈善捐款扣除{cap}。每捐 HK$100，實際付出 {a} 至 {b}。
zh-HK.d.benefit.zero: 您捐 {g}。以此入息水平無須繳付薪俸稅，捐款不會減少稅款。
zh-HK.d.benefit.capped: 受應評稅入息 35% 上限所限，可扣除 {taxed}；節省稅款 {s}。
zh-HK.d.benefit.ok: 您捐 {g}，全數可作認可慈善捐款扣除。每捐 HK$100，實際付出約 {per}。
zh-HK.d.announce.monthly: 每月 {a}，共 {n} 個月，全年合計 {total}。
zh-HK.d.rv.name: 請輸入收據抬頭姓名。
zh-HK.d.rv.ok: 多謝您。我們會先核對付款，核對後發出扣稅收據。

en.title: Donation tax calculator
en.s1.months.label: Months given this year of assessment
en.s1.months.hint: The year of assessment ends 31 March. The deduction uses your total for that year.
en.s1.band.label: Your assessable income this year, roughly
en.s1.band.hint: Before allowances; the basic allowance is assumed at HK$145,000.
en.s1.band.aria: Your assessable income this year, roughly
en.s1.band.r0.label: Below HK$145,000
en.s1.band.r16.label: HK$5,000,000 and above
en.s1.band.note: Above HK$2,132,500 the standard rate takes over — 15% on the first HK$5 million, 16% above it — so the last two rungs fall rather than rise. That is how the tax is built, not a bug.
en.s1.exact.label: Assessable income for the year
en.s1.exact.hint: One figure instead of a range, worked through the bands and the 35% cap. Never sent, never stored.
en.s1.what.summary: What counts as a deductible gift
en.s1.what.body: Only money given to a charity approved under section 88 of the Inland Revenue Ordinance can be deducted. Money paid for something in return is not a donation — raffle tickets, auction purchases, dinner seats, sponsorship that buys advertising. At or below the basic allowance you pay no salaries tax, so a gift saves you nothing.
en.s2.caption: Between the top and bottom of the range you chose.
en.s2.benefit: You give HK$1,300, all of it deductible. Every HK$100 costs you about HK$83.
en.s2.cap.def: The cap is 35% of assessable income for the year; an ordinary gift does not reach it.
en.s2.scope: One person, salaries tax only. An estimate, not tax advice.
en.s2.spouse.q: Can a couple combine the deduction?
en.s2.spouse.a: Partly. What you cannot use — including the part above the 35% cap — your spouse may claim on their own BIR60. Their claim is capped at 35% of their own income or profits, so an unused deduction does not pass across in full.
en.s3.lede: All three finish on the Foundation's donation page.
en.rc.lede: Three details: the name for the receipt, an email address, and the reference from your payment.
en.rc.threshold: A receipt is issued once your gifts for the year of assessment reach HK$100.
en.rc.name: Name on the receipt
en.rc.ref.hint: The transaction ID in your payment app, or on your card receipt.
en.rc.consent: I agree that the Foundation may use these details to match my gift and issue my tax receipt.
en.rc.disclink: Read the disclaimer before you send anything.
en.rc.keep: Keep the receipt for six years — the IRD may ask to see it.
en.rc.disc.body: An estimate only. Not tax advice, and no substitute for professional advice. It follows Inland Revenue Department rules for the year of assessment ending 31 March, covers the deduction for recognised charitable donations only, and allows nothing for other deductions, allowances or tax reductions. It does not cover profits tax, personal assessment or joint assessment. What you may deduct, and what you pay, rest with the Inland Revenue Department. The calculator collects and stores nothing; the name, email and reference you give here are used only to match your donation and issue your receipt.
en.foot.legal: * What you may deduct rests with the Inland Revenue Department. The cap is 35% of assessable income or profits; the tax saved is roughly the deductible amount × your rate, up to 17%.
en.d.cap.monthly: {a} a month × {n} months = {total} for the year.
en.d.cap.empty: Enter an amount and this fills in.
en.d.cap.unknown: No range chosen: HK$0 at one end, the top 17% at the other.
en.d.cap.range: From the two ends of the range you chose.
en.d.cap.same: The same at either end of the range you chose.
en.d.assume.exact: Assumed assessable income {inc}, the figure you entered.
en.d.capline.empty: The cap is 35% of assessable income for the year.
en.d.capline.exact.capped: The cap is 35% of assessable income for the year: {taxed} is deductible and the rest is not.
en.d.capline.exact.ok: The cap is 35% of assessable income for the year; not reached, so all of it is deductible.
en.d.capline.unknown: The cap is 35% of assessable income for the year; it is applied.
en.d.capline.zero: The cap is 35% of assessable income for the year; the gift is still deductible, but there is no tax to reduce.
en.d.capline.band.capped: The cap is 35% of assessable income for the year; at the floor of your range {d} is deductible.
en.d.capline.band.ok: The cap is 35% of assessable income for the year; at the floor of your range all of it is deductible.
en.d.benefit.empty: Enter an amount to see what it costs you.
en.d.benefit.range: {g} given, deductible{cap}. Every HK$100 costs you {a} to {b}.
en.d.benefit.zero: You give {g}. At this income you pay no salaries tax, so the gift saves you nothing.
en.d.benefit.capped: The 35% cap holds the deduction to {taxed}. Tax saved {s}.
en.d.benefit.ok: {g} given, all of it deductible as a recognised charitable donation. Every HK$100 costs you about {per}.
en.d.announce.monthly: {a} a month, {n} months, {total} for the year.
en.d.rv.name: Please enter the name for the receipt.
en.d.rv.mail: Please enter a valid email address.
en.d.rv.ref: Please enter the payment reference from your app or receipt.
en.d.rv.consent: Please tick the consent box first.
en.d.rv.ok: Thank you. We will match your payment first, then issue the tax receipt.
